description: This file contains utility functions and definitions for testing the starboard player, including test file lists, configuration generation, and helper functions for creating and writing to SbPlayer instances, as well as checking support for certain features.

methods.name: GetAudioTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a vector of audio test file names.

methods.name: GetVideoTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a vector of video test file names.

methods.name: GetPlayerOutputModes
methods.description: Returns a vector of supported SbPlayer output modes.

methods.name: GetKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a vector of key system strings, including empty string.

methods.name: GetSupportedSbPlayerTestConfigs
methods.description: Generates a list of supported SbPlayer test configurations based on key system.

methods.name: GetSbPlayerTestConfigName
methods.description: Generates a descriptive name for a given test configuration.

methods.name: DummyDecoderStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for decoder status callback.

methods.name: DummyPlayerStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for player status callback.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerCreate
methods.description: Creates an SbPlayer with specified parameters.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes samples to the SbPlayer from a VideoDmpReader.

methods.name: IsOutputModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific output mode is supported for given codecs and key system.

methods.name: IsPartialAudioSupported
methods.description: Checks if partial audio frames are supported based on API version.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthroughUsed
methods.description: Determines if audio passthrough (AC3/EAC3) is used based on test config.
